Description:
Situated on a sun-drenched, south-facing corner lot in the heart of Kitsilano, this beautiful 1,700-square-foot Craftsman-style character home seamlessly blends 1920s architecture with contemporary luxury and picturesque North Shore mountain views. Bathed in natural light through generous windows, the open-concept 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom interior features rich wood flooring, refined architectural millwork, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with top-tier Wolf gas appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and premium custom finishes ideal for entertaining. Outdoors, the home transitions to a private yard and patio space that captures maximum southern exposure. Beyond the front door, you are surrounded by the best of Vancouver’s Westside: steps from the newly rebuilt General Gordon Elementary, minutes from Kitsilano Secondary, and directly connected to the scenic Kitsilano Bike Path for effortless cycling to UBC or Downtown. The vibrant West 4th Avenue corridor is just around the corner, offering boutique shopping, organic grocers, local cafes, and celebrated neighborhood dining, while the iconic sands and saltwater pool of Kitsilano Beach are only a short stroll away.
